heroHeadline: Macron Says CIA Did Not Warn France of Russian Drone Attacks, Exposing NATO Intelligence-Sharing Gaps
heroSubtitle: French President Macron disclosed that the CIA failed to inform French intelligence services about possible Russian drone attacks, surfacing a significant rift in transatlantic intelligence sharing. The revelation follows earlier warnings that Russian sabotage operations across Europe have surged sharply, while officials assess no imminent conventional military attack on NATO territory.
footerNote: Data sourced from official NATO/SHAPE and member-state defense ministry statements, major outlets, and institutional analyses.
